name: Trinity Income Portfolio Skill/Agent Registry
description: Canonical versioned, discoverable, monetizable registry for Trinity Income Portfolio skills, agents, and templates. Shared engine in affiliate-agent-skills. Supports 100% keep or low-fee models, one-click deploy, template gallery, cross-agent registration (Hermes, Codex, Claude, Grok, Antigravity), MCP exposure, public-trust verification.

trinityBranding.tagline: Sovereign Agentic Passive Income OS — Earn • Automate • Compound

feeModels.100keep: Creator keeps 100% — platform earns via optional premium hosting/retainers

marketplaceMechanics.oneClickDeploy: Scripts deploy to Hermes profiles, Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity, or MCP-compatible hosts. Templates include install.sh, .env, skill symlinks.

crossAgentRegistration.Hermes: skills/ symlinks + profile create; MCP tools via hermes gateway
crossAgentRegistration.Codex: .codex/skills/ + exec prompts; export as standalone package
crossAgentRegistration.Grok: Grok CLI harness + prompts; native Imagine integration

mcpExposure.protocol: Model Context Protocol (MCP) 2025/2026 standard — any compatible agent (Claude Code, Codex, Grok, Cursor) can call Trinity actions natively.
